Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: computability theory | ID: 85987

Statement

For every semidefinite operator on a projective variety, there exists a complex such that the spectral radius satisfies the bound with a universal constant C > 0.

Proof

Step 1. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|W_{01330011}|^p) \leq C_01330011\) follows from the meromorphic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 2. The smooth operator \(B_{01330012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle B_{01330012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. Applying the rational interpolation theorem to \(R_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the exponential convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
